items.name: DataFrame
items.summary: Represents a logical set of rows with the same named columns.

methods.name: aggregate
methods.signature: fn aggregate(self, group_expr: Vec<Expr>, aggr_expr: Vec<Expr>) -> Result<DataFrame>
methods.summary: Return a new `DataFrame` that aggregates the rows of the current `DataFrame`, first optionally grouping by the given expressions.

methods.name: alias
methods.summary: Apply an alias to the DataFrame.

methods.name: cache
methods.summary: Cache DataFrame as a memory table.

methods.name: collect
methods.summary: Execute this `DataFrame` and buffer all resulting `RecordBatch`es  into memory.

methods.name: collect_partitioned
methods.summary: Executes this DataFrame and collects all results into a vector of vector of RecordBatch maintaining the input partitioning.

methods.name: count
methods.summary: Return the total number of rows in this `DataFrame`.

methods.name: create_physical_plan
methods.summary: Create a physical plan from this DataFrame.

methods.name: describe
methods.summary: Return a new `DataFrame` that has statistics for a DataFrame.

methods.name: distinct
methods.summary: Return a new `DataFrame` with all duplicated rows removed.

methods.name: distinct_on
methods.signature: fn distinct_on(self, on_expr: Vec<Expr>, select_expr: Vec<Expr>, sort_expr: Option<Vec<SortExpr>>) -> Result<DataFrame>
methods.summary: Return a new `DataFrame` with duplicated rows removed as per the specified expression list according to the provided sorting expressions grouped by the `DISTINCT ON` clause expressions.

methods.name: drop_columns
methods.signature: fn drop_columns<T>(self, columns: &[T]) -> Result<DataFrame> where T: Into<Column> + Clone
methods.summary: Returns a new DataFrame containing all columns except the specified columns.

methods.name: except
methods.summary: Calculate the exception of two [`DataFrame`]s.  The two [`DataFrame`]s must have exactly the same schema

methods.name: except_distinct
methods.summary: Calculate the distinct exception of two [`DataFrame`]s.  The two [`DataFrame`]s must have exactly the same schema

methods.name: execute_stream
methods.summary: Executes this DataFrame and returns a stream over a single partition

methods.name: execute_stream_partitioned
methods.summary: Executes this DataFrame and returns one stream per partition.

methods.name: explain
methods.signature: fn explain(self, verbose: bool, analyze: bool) -> Result<DataFrame>
methods.summary: Return a DataFrame with the explanation of its plan so far.

methods.name: explain_with_options
methods.summary: Return a DataFrame with the explanation of its plan so far.

methods.name: fill_nan
methods.summary: Fill NaN values in specified floating-point columns with a given value If no columns are specified (empty slice), applies to all columns Only floating-point columns are affected; other columns are left unchanged Only fills if the value can…

methods.name: fill_null
methods.summary: Fill null values in specified columns with a given value If no columns are specified (empty slice), applies to all columns Only fills if the value can be cast to the column's type

methods.name: filter
methods.summary: Return a DataFrame with only rows for which `predicate` evaluates to `true`.

methods.name: find_qualified_columns
methods.summary: Find qualified columns for this dataframe from names

methods.name: from_columns
methods.summary: Helper for creating DataFrame. # Example ``` use arrow::array::{ArrayRef, Int32Array, StringArray}; use datafusion::prelude::DataFrame; use std::sync::Arc; let id: ArrayRef = Arc::new(Int32Array::from(vec![1, 2, 3])); let name: ArrayRef =…

methods.name: intersect
methods.summary: Calculate the intersection of two [`DataFrame`]s.  The two [`DataFrame`]s must have exactly the same schema

methods.name: intersect_distinct
methods.summary: Calculate the distinct intersection of two [`DataFrame`]s.  The two [`DataFrame`]s must have exactly the same schema

methods.name: into_optimized_plan
methods.summary: Return the optimized [`LogicalPlan`] represented by this DataFrame.

methods.name: into_parts
methods.summary: Returns both the [`LogicalPlan`] and [`SessionState`] that comprise this [`DataFrame`]

methods.name: into_temporary_view
methods.summary: See [`Self::into_view`]. The returned [`TableProvider`] will create a transient table.

methods.name: into_unoptimized_plan
methods.summary: Return the [`LogicalPlan`] represented by this DataFrame without running any optimizers

methods.name: into_view
methods.summary: Converts this [`DataFrame`] into a [`TableProvider`] that can be registered as a table view using [`SessionContext::register_table`].

methods.name: join
methods.signature: fn join(self, right: DataFrame, join_type: JoinType, left_cols: &[&str], right_cols: &[&str], filter: Option<Expr>) -> Result<DataFrame>
methods.summary: Join this `DataFrame` with another `DataFrame` using explicitly specified columns and an optional filter expression.

methods.name: join_on
methods.signature: fn join_on(self, right: DataFrame, join_type: JoinType, on_exprs: impl IntoIterator<Item = Expr>) -> Result<DataFrame>
methods.summary: Join this `DataFrame` with another `DataFrame` using the specified expressions.

methods.name: limit
methods.signature: fn limit(self, skip: usize, fetch: Option<usize>) -> Result<DataFrame>
methods.summary: Returns a new `DataFrame` with a limited number of rows.

methods.name: logical_plan
methods.summary: Return a reference to the unoptimized [`LogicalPlan`] that comprises this DataFrame.

methods.name: new
methods.signature: fn new(session_state: SessionState, plan: LogicalPlan) -> Self
methods.summary: Create a new `DataFrame ` based on an existing `LogicalPlan`

methods.name: parse_sql_expr
methods.summary: Creates logical expression from a SQL query text. The expression is created and processed against the current schema.

methods.name: registry
methods.summary: Return a `FunctionRegistry` used to plan udf's calls

methods.name: repartition
methods.summary: Repartition a DataFrame based on a logical partitioning scheme.

methods.name: schema
methods.summary: Returns the `DFSchema` describing the output of this DataFrame.

methods.name: select
methods.signature: fn select(self, expr_list: impl IntoIterator<Item = impl Into<SelectExpr>>) -> Result<DataFrame>
methods.summary: Project arbitrary expressions (like SQL SELECT expressions) into a new `DataFrame`.

methods.name: select_columns
methods.summary: Filter the DataFrame by column. Returns a new DataFrame only containing the specified columns.

methods.name: select_exprs
methods.summary: Project arbitrary list of expression strings into a new `DataFrame`. Method will parse string expressions into logical plan expressions.

methods.name: show
methods.summary: Execute the `DataFrame` and print the results to the console.

methods.name: show_limit
methods.signature: async fn show_limit(self, num: usize) -> Result<()>
methods.summary: Execute the `DataFrame` and print only the first `num` rows of the result to the console.

methods.name: sort
methods.summary: Sort the DataFrame by the specified sorting expressions.

methods.name: sort_by
methods.summary: Apply a sort by provided expressions with default direction

methods.name: task_ctx
methods.summary: Return a new [`TaskContext`] which would be used to execute this DataFrame

methods.name: to_string
methods.summary: Execute the `DataFrame` and return a string representation of the results.

methods.name: union
methods.summary: Calculate the union of two [`DataFrame`]s, preserving duplicate rows.

methods.name: union_by_name
methods.summary: Calculate the union of two [`DataFrame`]s using column names, preserving duplicate rows.

methods.name: union_by_name_distinct
methods.summary: Calculate the union of two [`DataFrame`]s using column names with all duplicated rows removed.

methods.name: union_distinct
methods.summary: Calculate the distinct union of two [`DataFrame`]s.

methods.name: unnest_columns
methods.summary: Expand multiple list/struct columns into a set of rows and new columns.

methods.name: unnest_columns_with_options
methods.signature: fn unnest_columns_with_options(self, columns: &[&str], options: UnnestOptions) -> Result<DataFrame>
methods.summary: Expand multiple list columns into a set of rows, with behavior controlled by [`UnnestOptions`].

methods.name: window
methods.summary: Return a new DataFrame that adds the result of evaluating one or more window functions ([`Expr::WindowFunction`]) to the existing columns

methods.name: with_column
methods.signature: fn with_column(self, name: &str, expr: Expr) -> Result<DataFrame>
methods.summary: Add or replace a column in the DataFrame.

methods.name: with_column_renamed
methods.signature: fn with_column_renamed(self, old_name: impl Into<String>, new_name: &str) -> Result<DataFrame>
methods.summary: Rename one column by applying a new projection. This is a no-op if the column to be renamed does not exist.

methods.name: with_param_values
methods.signature: fn with_param_values(self, query_values: impl Into<ParamValues>) -> Result<Self>
methods.summary: Replace all parameters in logical plan with the specified values, in preparation for execution.

methods.name: write_csv
methods.signature: async fn write_csv(self, path: &str, options: DataFrameWriteOptions, writer_options: Option<CsvOptions>) -> Result<Vec<RecordBatch>, DataFusionError>
methods.summary: Execute the `DataFrame` and write the results to CSV file(s).

methods.name: write_json
methods.signature: async fn write_json(self, path: &str, options: DataFrameWriteOptions, writer_options: Option<JsonOptions>) -> Result<Vec<RecordBatch>, DataFusionError>
methods.summary: Execute the `DataFrame` and write the results to JSON file(s).

methods.name: write_parquet
methods.signature: async fn write_parquet(self, path: &str, options: DataFrameWriteOptions, writer_options: Option<TableParquetOptions>) -> Result<Vec<RecordBatch>, DataFusionError>
methods.summary: Execute the `DataFrame` and write the results to Parquet file(s).

methods.name: write_table
methods.signature: async fn write_table(self, table_name: &str, write_options: DataFrameWriteOptions) -> Result<Vec<RecordBatch>, DataFusionError>
methods.summary: Execute this `DataFrame` and write the results to `table_name`.

methods.name: with_partition_by
methods.summary: Sets the partition_by columns for output partitioning

methods.name: with_single_file_output
methods.summary: Set the single_file_output value to true or false

methods.name: with_sort_by
methods.summary: Sets the sort_by columns for output sorting
